label: MRtrix3 fixelcrop
description:
Crop/remove fixels from sparse fixel image using a binary fixel mask

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: input_fixel_directory
input_slots.description: input fixel directory, all data files and directions file will be cropped and saved in the output fixel directory

input_slots.label: input_fixel_mask
input_slots.description: the input fixel data file defining which fixels to crop. Fixels with zero values will be removed

output_slots.label: output_fixel_directory
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Crop/remove fixels from sparse fixel image using a binary fixel mask
